data.name: Valdivia AllStars
data.detailed_description:
Valdivia AllStars

Fast, no-nonsense 1-on-1 arcade basketball: pick your idol, hit the court and win the duel bucket by bucket. Set in Valdivia — a cradle of Chilean basketball — and called LIVE by an announcer who won't miss a single play.

No teams, no filler: just you, your rival and the rim. Easy to pick up, hard to put down. Every match feels like a TV broadcast, with a roaring crowd, real history and an announcer who turns up the volume when things heat up.

Features

  • Arcade 1-on-1 duels — Fast, accessible matches. Fakes, layups and buzzer-beating threes: easy to reach, a whole other thing to master.

  • An announcer who lives every play — Full Spanish play-by-play that calls each bucket, loses it over your threes and drops trivia about the city, its history and its players. No two matches sound alike.

  • A love letter to Valdivia — Players, arenas and stories inspired by the city's basketball heritage. Ball out in recognizable venues, each with its own anthem.

  • Tournament & Friendly modes — Take on a lineup of rivals on the road to the cup, step through the locker room before each duel, and lift the trophy as champion.

  • Timing-based shooting & dribble moves — A shot meter like the big leagues: release at the right moment. Crossover and between-the-legs to leave your rival frozen.

  • Instant Replay — Relive your best play with a free camera, slow motion and playback speeds, and save the shot straight to your gallery.

  • Rankings & achievements — Fight for the daily and monthly top spots and unlock achievements as you take over the court.

  • Play your way — Full support for gamepad, keyboard and touch.

Step onto the court. The city is watching.
